label: Email Reader
description: An open email in a light Gmail-style client: sender row, subject, body, and a marker-sweep highlight over the money quote. The reading verb (email-compose is the writing verb) -- use it when a message ARRIVES and something inside it matters.

body.label: Body
body.description: Email body; paragraphs split on newlines. Mark the money quote with *asterisks* (or use highlight_quote).

highlight_quote.label: Highlight quote
highlight_quote.description: Exact substring of the body to sweep with the highlight. Ignored if the body already carries *asterisk* marks or the substring is not found.

highlight_style.label: Highlight style
highlight_style.description: 'marker' (default): full-height yellow wash. 'underline': a 3px rule drawing along the baseline -- use for a film-through-line treatment in a brand color.

highlight_color.label: Highlight color
highlight_color.description: CSS color for the sweep (default: marker #ffe9a8, underline #393bf5). Marker colors must stay LIGHT -- the ink over them is dark.

script_actions.description: Click a toolbar action or a point in the message
